items.title: Connect actor helper calls to the production TTS workflow
items.completion_note: The gnisu production request completed StartTts, direct blocking Kokoro playback, and StopTts. The actor returned to idle, duplicate File Watcher playback was absent from the successful path, and the repository helper replaced the stale capability-discovery helper instance.
integration_sequence: Inventory the production TTS action and every completion or error path
Map one TTS identity to one actor ID and persisted token-global name
Call StartTts immediately before audio playback
Call StopTts after successful playback and on cleanup or failure
Verify unmapped identities still use the existing non-actor path
Repeat for remaining actor identities after the first mapping passes
acceptance_criteria: The first supported TTS identity resolves to the intended actor ID and token variable
StartTts runs before audio playback
StopTts runs after blocking playback completion
The actor returns to idle after the matching stop
Raw actor tokens remain outside repository files and logs

items.title: Run an end-to-end multi-actor TTS isolation test
items.completion_note: Both mapped identities used distinct actors and completed isolated StartTts, direct blocking Kokoro playback, and StopTts lifecycles. An unmapped broadcaster identity retained direct blocking OpenAI playback. The owner accepted the existing single queue as intentional stream behavior, so overlap and concurrent same-actor cleanup are not applicable production requirements.

design_decision.reason: Keep live streams clean and understandable by allowing one synthesized voice at a time.
design_decision.underlying_helper_protection: Actor-scoped stale-session protection was already live-tested independently.

test_sequence: Map a second production identity to a different actor
Verify each mapped identity activates only its assigned actor
Submit mapped requests close together and confirm the queue processes them one at a time
Verify each actor returns to idle before the next queued mapped identity begins
Run an unmapped identity and confirm the original direct blocking fallback path remains unchanged
Retain the previously validated actor-scoped expression, emote, and stale-session helper behavior
acceptance_criteria: Every configured AI voice activates only its assigned actor
Speaking starts before audible playback and returns to idle afterward
The production queue intentionally prevents overlapping voices
Queued mapped identities remain isolated across sequential playback
An unmapped identity uses the existing non-actor path
Actor-scoped expression, emote, and stale-session helper checks remain passed
No raw actor token appears in logs or repository files

maintenance.rule: When an item is completed, record the result in project-status.json, remove or mark the roadmap item complete, update updated_at in project-status.json, next-steps.json, and repository-checks.json, and add a concise CHANGELOG.md entry.
maintenance.checkout_rule: Use npm ci, then run npm run status:check after fetching and before beginning the next roadmap item.
maintenance.security: Never place live tokens, authenticated OBS URLs, or certificate secrets in roadmap files.
